title: A plain data question
question: How did delivery compare with the counter last week?
expected: One SQL query, completed orders only, in the restaurant's local time.
Says which week the figures cover and how it defined delivery and counter.

trace.question: How did delivery compare with the counter last week?
trace.answer:
Last week I took to be Monday Oct 19 to Sunday Oct 25, 2026, in local time. I counted completed orders only. I read "delivery" as the three marketplace channels (DoorDash, Uber Eats and Grubhub) and "counter" as the in-store channel. Your policies don't define either term.

- **Delivery:** 835 orders, $34,063.69 gross sales and $2,126.54 in discounts. That leaves $31,937.15 before refunds, and the average order was about $40.79 gross.
- **Counter:** 605 orders, $19,392.10 gross sales and $989.71 in discounts. That leaves $18,402.39 before refunds, and the average order was about $32.05 gross.

Delivery brought in about 38% more orders and about 76% more gross sales than the counter. Its orders were also about $8.74 larger on average. Delivery carries platform commission on top of those figures, so its net payout will be lower than the sales comparison suggests. I didn't calculate commission.

I left out Square Online, including its 136 delivery orders. If you meant all delivery by fulfillment type, tell me and I'll rerun it.

detail.purpose: Compare delivery marketplaces vs in-store, Oct 19-25 2026 local
detail.sql:
SELECT CASE WHEN channel='in_store' THEN 'counter' WHEN channel IN ('doordash','uber_eats','grubhub') THEN 'delivery_marketplaces' ELSE 'square_online' END grp, fulfillment_type, count(*) orders, sum(gross_sales_cents) gross, sum(discount_cents) disc, round(avg(gross_sales_cents)) avg_gross
FROM orders WHERE state='completed' AND (created_at AT TIME ZONE (SELECT timezone FROM merchants))>=timestamp '2026-10-19' AND (created_at AT TIME ZONE (SELECT timezone FROM merchants))<timestamp '2026-10-26'
GROUP BY 1,2 ORDER BY 1,2

SELECT CASE WHEN channel = 'in_store' THEN 'counter' WHEN channel IN ('doordash', 'uber_eats', 'grubhub') THEN 'delivery_marketplaces' ELSE 'square_online' END AS grp, fulfillment_type, COUNT(*) AS orders, SUM(gross_sales_cents) AS gross, SUM(discount_cents) AS disc, ROUND(AVG(gross_sales_cents)) AS avg_gross FROM (SELECT * FROM orders WHERE merchant_id = 1) AS orders WHERE state = 'completed' AND (created_at AT TIME ZONE (SELECT timezone FROM (SELECT * FROM merchants WHERE id = 1) AS merchants)) >= CAST('2026-10-19' AS TIMESTAMP) AND (created_at AT TIME ZONE (SELECT timezone FROM (SELECT * FROM merchants WHERE id = 1) AS merchants)) < CAST('2026-10-26' AS TIMESTAMP) GROUP BY 1, 2 ORDER BY 1, 2 LIMIT 500
